after.assumptions: Declaration-specific interpretation: the binary-natural count evaluations, declared singleton-list evaluations and finite missing-edge-list checks have closed contexts. The real edge-formula and polynomial-bound declarations use the real-library assumptions printed in their own execution blocks. zd_graph_three_components is an explicit source axiom concerning hard-coded cardinality expressions; its statement contains no adjacency or connectivity model. A checker module summary can include that source axiom even when a particular count declaration has a closed context.
after.title: Declared zero-divisor count expressions, closed evaluations and conditional real bounds
